title: Pricing the Replacement Going Out on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Exchange
content:
The replacement going out is priced as follows. Where the membership standing on the profile is active and the tier's published member only discount is the top member discount or more, the replacement is priced at today's shelf price less the tier's published member only discount. Where the membership standing on the profile is active and the tier's published member only discount is above nothing but below the top member discount, the replacement is priced at today's shelf price less half the tier's published member only discount. In any other case the replacement is priced at today's shelf price.

The top member discount is 5 per cent.

## What is read

The membership read is the one standing on the customer's profile on Northbeam Circle Membership: whether it stands active and the member only discount its tier publishes. The price this fixes is the price of the replacement going out on the Northbeam Returns and Restocking exchange.

| The membership | Its tier's published member only discount | The replacement is priced at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| active | 5 per cent or more | today's shelf price less that discount |
| active | above nothing but below 5 per cent | today's shelf price less half that discount |
| active | nothing | today's shelf price |
| not active | any figure | today's shelf price |

Taking a discount off today's shelf price means taking that percentage of the shelf price off it; taking half the discount off means taking half of that percentage of the shelf price off it.

## Both sides of the threshold, on hypothetical inputs

Take today's shelf price at 800.00 USD.

*A membership standing active whose tier publishes a member only discount of 8 per cent.* Eight is 5 or more, so the replacement is priced at 800.00 USD less 8 per cent of it, that is 736.00 USD.

*A membership standing active whose tier publishes 5 per cent.* Five is 5 or more, so the replacement is priced at 800.00 USD less 5 per cent, that is 760.00 USD.

*A membership standing active whose tier publishes 4 per cent.* Four is above nothing and below 5, so half of it, 2 per cent, comes off: the replacement is priced at 784.00 USD.

*A membership standing active whose tier publishes no member only discount.* The replacement is priced at today's shelf price, 800.00 USD.

*A cancelled membership whose tier publishes 8 per cent.* It does not stand active, so the replacement is priced at today's shelf price, 800.00 USD.
